status: component check before any new full candidate
hypothesis: A clean program that is worse as a whole can still contain complementary useful columns. The first two candidates retain only each attempt's best matrices; for site-success both attempts retain the identical single-table fallback, so their union offers no relational information.
observed_validation_evidence: V1 site-success has a clean 37-column program at MAE .395637, just behind the .394914 fallback. V2 has clean 14- and 28-column views at .407817 and .416129. None can enter the existing best-only cold union.
component: On a separate k1 database, replay the own v2 fallback and the best clean view of each cold attempt. Take up to eight positive-gain columns per view, deduplicate by train and validation values, and select a bounded union with the unchanged fixed learner and validation labels only.
gate: Proceed only if validation beats the fallback by the pre-existing .002 relative MAE margin, and the assembled SQL reproduces values and passes a fresh complete leakage audit. All queries, fits, costs and failed checks remain recorded. This is not a test-quality result.
information_boundary: Archived own candidates are component controls only, never initial programs for any new from-empty arm. No test labels, scores or other systems' SQL enter the component. The v1/v2 test results are already known; development remains explicitly post-hoc.
